Step 2: isExpired(exp, 30) — 30-second skew confirmed (line 153). PASS.
Step 2 fast-path: returns downstream(access) directly when token is valid. PASS.
Step 3: checks for refresh cookie; returns envelope401('AUTH_MISSING') if absent. PASS.
Step 4: POSTs to ${IDENTITY_URL}/api/v1/identity/user/refresh with refreshToken in body. PASS.
Step 4 error handling: catches network errors, returns envelope502. PASS.
Step 6 (AUTH_REVOKED/AUTH_INVALID/401): calls envelope401Cleared which appends Max-Age=0 Set-Cookie for both cookies. PASS.
Step 5: extracts accessToken + refreshToken, calls downstream(accessToken), then appends rotated cookies to the mutable cloned headers. PASS.

NOTE: Step numbering in implementation comments has Steps 5 and 6 swapped relative to TD pseudocode (implementation does refresh→forward as step 5, revoked-clear as step 6; TD pseudocode does revoked-clear as step 6 and cookie-rotation as step 5). Logic is functionally correct regardless of comment label order.

gaps_and_deviations.description: /cart is fully client-side (useEffect fetch) rather than the TD-specified 'Server Component shell + Client line-item controls'. Functionally equivalent for v0.1 but deviates from the SSR/hydration pattern specified.

27 of 34 TD-specified dedicated route handlers are served by the catch-all stub rather than dedicated files. The stub correctly lacks per-route ADMIN guards and idempotency forwarding. Acceptable for v0.1 scope; must be resolved before checkout.commit and admin write handlers go live.
No tests/unit/ or tests/e2e/ directories found. TD requires vitest unit tests (isJwtExpired, orchestrator 6-step paths, in-flight dedup) and Playwright e2e suite. Absent entirely.

clearAccessCookie and clearRefreshCookie strings omit SameSite=Lax. While Max-Age=0 deletion does not need SameSite to function, consistency with set attributes is best practice and expected by some strict browsers.

TD specifies env vars as BACKEND_IDENTITY_BASE_URL, BACKEND_CATALOG_BASE_URL, etc. Implementation uses BACKEND_IDENTITY_URL, BACKEND_CATALOG_URL (without _BASE). Consistent internally but deviates from TD naming. Low risk if docker-compose and .env.example align.

The catch-all /api/proxy/[...path] always invokes withAuth. TD notes catalog.product.list and catalog.product.detail are 'public passthrough'. Dedicated handlers correctly handle this. If traffic routes to catch-all for catalog reads, unauthenticated users get AUTH_MISSING instead of public data. Currently harmless since dedicated handlers exist, but a risk if dedicated handlers are removed.

summary.notes: All 8 conformance checks pass or partially pass with no blocking failures. The 6-step withAuth, cookie attributes, CSP, idempotency primitives, and toolchain fully conform to TD. Main gaps are: /cart not implemented as SC shell (low), 27 handlers delegated to catch-all stub (expected for v0.1), and test suite entirely absent (must be addressed before v1 release).
